contracts: aayu grill <type> --edit <n> --body <file> [--title]: writes a checked body through the actions log, only before Ready and outside a mission lock; grill checks link targets as Ready does, and planning.Paths reads comma-separated paths (#1179)

inbox card kinds baseline and approve-to-build (inboxKinds, internal/cli/inbox.go): each approves through partRun.approve or approveToBuild unchanged, under the inbox session's one presence check (#1172, #1173)
missions/<f>/plan.json: a final BUGS milestone holds every open Bug by default; a Bug filed during the mission joins it; the BUGS gate needs a proof pack per Bug on the ledger (#1174)
the morning order (decisions, baselines, Approve to build, mission start) and the closing line The day is set (#1175)
evening card kind: one per story agreed that morning, each criterion next to its evidence from proof/<n>/<sha>/; accept or comment, recorded in missions/<f>/reviews.jsonl (#1176)
The day is proven, only with full evidence, through inboxCheer and the milestone hook day-proven (#1177)
overnight card: missions/overnight/<date>.json records each run and its bounds; aayu mission next starts no story outside [time] business_hours (#1178)
rollback: Each card kind and the --edit flag go away with a revert of its story. New ledger files (reviews.jsonl, overnight/<date>.json) stay readable and unused. A BUGS milestone is an ordinary milestone name, so a reverted binary runs it as any other. No record is rewritten.
